propositions: Free-text schema extraction remains heuristic; a trailing valid decoy can win over intended content, and models fence-wrap quoted JSON so markdown fences cannot reliably delimit output.
An explicit output channel using line-anchored sentinel markers `<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>>` and `<<<END>>>` makes payload location a stated contract, preventing decoys outside the markers from winning.

Extraction scans for complete marker block pairs in document order, iterates blocks in reverse (last-first), and returns the first block whose content validates; if no block validates, raises the last block's error (fail-closed).
Markerless replies and incomplete marker pairs fall back to the existing schema-filtered selection pipeline unchanged, preserving backward compatibility with legacy transcripts.
The bounded-retry prompt must name the same markers as the first attempt to maintain consistent channel semantics across the fail-closed retry path.
